requirement: The system shall provide a single packaged UI, CLI, SDK, and agent-facing API across supported platforms.
The system shall discover physical devices, realms, sessions, seats, surfaces, resources, and endpoint capabilities.
The system shall preserve stable IDs across reconnects and distinguish identity from transient address or display order.
The system shall present both a simplified workspace UI and an expert graph/patchbay UI.
The system shall serialize, version, activate, diff, and roll back workspace graphs.
The system shall expose health, pressure, and route status without requiring users to inspect each backend.
Every connectable capability shall be represented by typed ports with format, timing, security, and locality metadata.
A desired link shall be distinct from its compiled route.
Route compilation shall search locality tiers from least expensive to most remote, subject to policy.
The compiler shall eliminate unnecessary copy, serialization, codec, color-conversion, resampling, and relay stages.
The compiler shall produce a route explanation with considered alternatives and rejected constraints.
Route changes shall be transactional with prepare, validate, commit, abort, and rollback.
Recursive capture/route loops shall be detected and blocked.
Routes shall replan when topology/capabilities change, but shall not silently violate hard constraints.
A central broker shall route physical and virtual keyboard, mouse, controller, pen, touch, and MIDI input.
Input focus shall be governed by exclusive leases and monotonically increasing fencing tokens.
Focus transfer shall synthesize releases for all held keys/buttons before revoking the old route.
Absolute desktop pointer and raw-relative capture modes shall be explicit and mutually safe.
Users shall independently cycle input focus, output focus, or both.
A local break-glass input path shall remain available.
Agents shall not acquire human input focus without an explicit grant or policy.
The system shall support takeover, extend, portal, mirror/pin, and audio-only presentation modes.

requirement: The system shall inventory CPU topology, NUMA, caches, accelerators, memory domains, storage, NICs, PCIe paths, thermals, and power state.
Tasks and objects shall declare capabilities, locality, security, consistency, deadline, and resource constraints.
Placement shall minimize predicted total completion cost including queueing, compute, state movement, data transfer, synchronization, result return, contention, and risk.
The runtime shall track object identity, versions, authority, replicas, caches, and residency.
The runtime shall move compute to data or data to compute based on measured total cost.
Placement granularity may reach task, function, syscall, operation, or accelerator-kernel boundaries where interposition exists.
The runtime shall fuse repeated fine-grained decisions into execution regions and split regions when conditions diverge.
The runtime shall support prefetch, replication, speculative execution, cancellation, and cache eviction policies.
The runtime shall support mobility levels: surface projection, semantic handoff, application checkpoint, process checkpoint, VM migration, and workload rematerialization.
The runtime shall never represent remote memory or VRAM as uniform local capacity without visible latency/consistency semantics.
Work shall be classified into RT0, RT1, RT2, RT3, RT4, Bulk, and Background service classes.
Resource reservations shall extend across CPU, GPU, encoder/decoder, memory bandwidth, storage I/O, network, thermal, and power constraints.
Background builds, tests, inference, and agents shall be subordinate to declared foreground deadlines.
The scheduler shall evict or relocate competing work before distributing tightly coupled game/audio critical paths.
The system shall support explicit degradation ladders for frame rate, chroma, bitrate, resolution, and optional effects.
The system shall expose admission-control failure rather than overcommit a hard real-time route.
Device enrollment shall use mutually authenticated identities and revocable short-lived credentials.
